bullets.text: A student in Tiruvallur district was arrested for trying to set a college bus on fire, and the office should monitor student safety.
A man died after falling into an open stormwater drain in Ambattur, and the office must ensure safety measures are placed at all pits.
The collector warned Thiruvallur fishermen not to venture into the sea due to a low-pressure area, and local officials must enforce this.
The government will establish 12 mini taluk offices in Chennai to improve revenue services, and the constituency team should track local implementation.
The draft electoral roll for Chennai shows 29.15 lakh voters, and the team should review the voter data for Velachery.
A new five-screen PVR multiplex is opening at XB Mall in Velachery in December 2026, boosting local entertainment.
Police seized fifty lakh rupees of hawala cash in a car in Thiruvallur, and the district team should monitor the ongoing investigation.
District collector Kavitha released the draft voter list showing 32,39,301 voters across ten constituencies, which the district team should review.
Farmers in Ponneri urged officials to set up a green gram procurement center during a grievance meeting, and the district office should follow up.
Chennai Traffic Police will introduce Edge AI technology to monitor parking violations, and the portfolio team should review the rollout.
The Tamil Nadu police technology wing plans to install 2,545 AI-enabled CCTV cameras across six cities, and the department should oversee progress.
MeitY is probing apps over worker data collection practices for AI training, and the portfolio team should monitor privacy compliance.
An opposition leader questioned the TVK government over children day events, and the office should monitor political reactions.
A police case was registered against a TVK functionary following a sexual harassment complaint from a woman office-bearer, and the office must watch developments.
Analysts discussed whether the honeymoon period has ended for the TVK government amid political criticism, and the office should track political sentiment.
